title: 第1283章 太古赤峰金第1282章 三眼女蛾
slug: 剑问九州第1286章星域虫潮
content_zh:
要不怎么说世间一切法，几乎找不到比雷法更全面的了。
对付正道修士，劈神魂就对了。
要是搞邪修，那更是逮哪劈哪。
至于打不过？
没关系，雷法遁术，那更是夯到爆。
一线万里什么的，压根不在话下。有能耐的还能直接劈开虚空，乾坤挪移跑路。
这一点，张天真是极有发言权的。
帝路尽头，虫族女皇已经被劈得不知天地为何物了。
女皇气急败坏，神通尽出，千丝缚道，尾端吐出银色丝线，水火不侵，硬生生隔开雷道倾轧，方得喘息，便汇聚七境道基，三只眼瞳当中仿若有千万瞳孔，幻影重叠交错，竟是要行擒王之举，霍乱白泽的心神，从根源上瓦解雷道法则。
白泽守正持心，默念一声“心无挂碍”，灵台金光大作，登时远离颠倒梦想，说道：“天下难持者莫如心，天下易染者莫如欲。虫皇，你倒是有几分手段，可惜道爷不吃这一套。”
那道人单手掐诀，道化阴阳，一刀递出，雷法幻影皆入局，刀罡流转黑白二气，纵横捭阖，劈得此方巢穴轰然炸碎！
“！？”
刀罡越过千丝缚道，直斩三眼女皇。
“啊啊啊啊啊！！——”
那虫皇被刀罡正面命中，登时发出痛苦惨叫，褪去一层皮囊，仿若金蝉脱壳，头也不回，直往巢穴深处遁逃。
这天灵大陆怎么会孕育出如此怪胎！
分明方入七境，道域也并不稳健，哪来的这般骇人杀力！
“此时要走，岂不晚哉？”
白泽提刀便追，雷法傍身刀罡开路，径直杀入虫巢核心，无人能挡。
“你不是大帝，你在耍我！”三眼女皇终究是怕了，“你是天人！尊驾饶我一命，我愿为奴，侍奉尊驾！”

白泽一阵恶寒。
“你倒也得能拿得出手！”
那道人雷法再出，体内本命飞剑铮然作响，镇国刀游龙而出，两相配合，便要取那虫皇性命。
“轰咔！”
雷光狰狞。
慌乱之中，三眼女皇祭出一块磨盘大的金石。此石来头极大，乃是太古赤峰金，坚硬无比，又被荒域剑修称为“神人磨剑石”。
“铛！”
镇国刀哀鸣一声，白泽浑身一震，若非那柄狭刀沾染了五彩仙光气息，当场就得被太古赤峰金砸断！
那道人微微错愕，虫皇已经硬抗雷法劈砍，拼着跌境的代价冲出巢穴。
“无妄渊不会放过你，本皇必要毁灭天灵大陆！”三眼女皇厉声叫嚣。
白泽“啧”了一声，杀心已起，本命飞剑神通顺势而出，登时禁锁此方天地，那虫皇一时间被死死定身，动弹不得！
“没人教你逃命的时候不要放狠话吗？”
那道人一刀斩出，刀芒撕裂虚空，生生将那虫皇对半劈开！
旋即雷法便荡平整个虫族巢穴，连虫卵都没放过一个。
“倒是没想到一个虫族身上，竟然有这种宝物。”白泽对着那磨盘大的太古赤峰金啧啧称奇。
如今第二把本命飞剑已成，可孕养飞剑绝非易事，他恰好缺一块磨砺剑锋的磨剑石。
还有能温养剑气的剑鞘。
从王家老八那里搞来的剑鞘已经炸碎，寻常天材地宝，白泽也看不上眼。
content_en:
If we talk about all the Dharma in the world, it is almost impossible to find one that is more comprehensive than the Lei Dharma.
To deal with the righteous monks, just split the soul.
If someone engages in evil cultivating, they will be beaten wherever they are caught.
As for being unable to defeat him?
It doesn't matter, the lightning escape technique is even more powerful.
Thousands of miles and so on, it's not a big deal. Those who have the ability can directly split the void and move the universe away.
Zhang Tianzhen has a strong say in this point.
At the end of the Imperial Road, the Zerg Queen had been hacked to the point where she no longer knew what the world was like.
The Queen was so angry that she unleashed her magical powers. She tied the Dao with thousands of threads and spewed out silver threads from the end. She was invulnerable to water and fire. She was forced to separate from the thunder path and squeezed. Only then could she catch her breath. Then she gathered the seven realms of Taoism. There seemed to be millions of pupils in her three eyes. The phantoms overlapped and intertwined. She actually wanted to capture the king. Cholera Bai Ze's mind destroyed the law of thunder path from the root.
Bai Ze kept his mind straight and recited silently, "Heart has no worries." The golden light of the spiritual platform glowed. He immediately turned away from the upside-down dream and said: "The only thing in the world that is difficult to control is the heart, and the only thing in the world that is easy to be stained is the desire. Insect King, you do have some tricks, but it's a pity that the Taoist master doesn't accept this trick."
The Taoist made a secret with one hand, turned the Tao into yin and yang, and extended the sword with one stroke. All the phantoms of thunder and lightning entered the game. The black and white energy flowed through the sword, slashing vertically and horizontally, smashing the nest into pieces!
"!?"
The sword crossed the thousand-wire bound road and cut straight into the three-eyed queen.
"Ahhhhhhh!!——"
The insect king was hit in the front by the sword, and he immediately screamed in pain, peeling off a layer of skin, like a golden cicada taking off its shell, and fled deep into the lair without looking back.
How could this Tianling Continent give birth to such a freak!
Mingming has entered the Seventh Realm, and the Dao Realm is not stable. How could such terrifying killing power come from!
"Isn't it too late to leave now?"
Bai Ze raised his sword and gave chase. Lei Fa opened the way with his sword and went straight into the core of the insect nest. No one could stop him.
"You are not the emperor, you are playing tricks on me!" The three-eyed queen was finally afraid, "You are a heavenly being! Your Majesty, please spare my life. I am willing to be your slave and serve you!"
Bai Ze felt a chill.
"You have to be able to do it!"
The Taoist's thunder method came out again, the flying sword in his body clanged loudly, and the Zhenguo sword came out as a dragon. The two of them cooperated to take the life of the insect emperor.
"Boom!"
The lightning is ferocious.
In panic, the Three-Eyed Queen sacrificed a gold stone as big as a millstone. This stone has a great origin. It is ancient Chifeng gold, which is extremely hard. It is also called the "god's sword sharpening stone" by the sword cultivator in the wilderness.
"Cang!"
Zhenguo Dao whined, and Bai Ze was shocked. If the narrow knife hadn't been contaminated with the aura of the five-color fairy light, it would have been broken by the ancient Chifeng Gold on the spot!
The Taoist was slightly shocked. The Insect King had already resisted the lightning attack and rushed out of the lair at the cost of falling.
"Wuwangyuan will not let you go, I will destroy Tianling Continent!" The Three-Eyed Queen screamed.
Bai Ze let out a "tsk", his murderous intention was already aroused, and his natal flying sword magical power came out, immediately locking the world. The Insect King was immobilized for a moment, unable to move!
"Didn't anyone teach you not to say harsh words when you're running for your life?"
The Taoist slashed out with his sword, and the light of the sword tore through the void, splitting the Insect King in half!
Immediately, the thunder method wiped out the entire insect nest, not even a single insect egg was spared.
"I didn't expect that a Zerg would have such a treasure." Bai Ze marveled at the ancient Chifeng gold that was as big as a millstone.
Now that the second natal flying sword is ready, it is not easy to raise a flying sword. He just lacks a whetstone to sharpen the sword's edge.
There is also a scabbard that can warm up the sword energy.
The scabbard obtained from the Wang family's eldest son had been blown to pieces. Even Baize looked down upon the ordinary natural and earthly treasures.
